当前是无时间戳快照上的回顾性分类评估，测试集在历史分析中曾被查看。若用于销户前筛选，需要另行确定特征时点与预测窗口。公开数据来源按项目文档记录，本地文件与发布方身份未独立绑定。模型分数未校准；业务成本与活动效果未测得。详细运行与修订记录见[新旧对比](新旧对比.md)，不影响将现有结果用于形成待实施的服务提案。

### Evaluation scope

This is retrospective classification on an untimestamped snapshot; the test set was viewed in historical analysis. Screening before account closure would require feature timing and a prediction window. The public source follows project documentation; local-file identity has not been independently bound to the publisher. Scores are uncalibrated, and campaign costs and effects have not been measured. Execution and revision details are in the [version notes](新旧对比.md). The current results can still inform service proposals for future implementation.

At the frozen threshold of 0.275, customers are divided into true positives (TP), false positives (FP), false negatives (FN) and true negatives (TN). Each example is closest to its group's median score, with ties broken by original row index. The four examples illustrate outcomes and are not population profiles.
